Limit[n=5]
  Sort[keys=total_spend DESC]
    Project[customer.nation AS nation, num_orders, total_spend, avg_order_spend]
      Filter[sum(orders.total_price) > 10000.0]
        Aggregate[group=customer.nation, aggs=count(*) AS num_orders, sum(orders.total_price) AS total_spend, avg(orders.total_price) AS avg_order_spend]
          Filter[orders.order_date >= '1995-01-01']
            Join[kind=inner, cond=customer.id = orders.cust_id]
              Scan[customer]
              Scan[orders]
